facts.fact: The Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act, 2014 (Act 2 of 2014, assented 28 March 2014, repealing the 1987 Act) establishes the Seychelles Bureau of Standards as a body corporate (s.3) with the function of preparing draft standards and declaring them Seychelles Standards by Gazette notice (s.4(b), s.14); the Act commences on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice, which this text does not give.

systems.owner: Government of Seychelles (body corporate under the Minister responsible for Industry)

note: No standard on information technology or data is named, so no published fact; the Bureau's power to assess and certify manufacturing, process or management systems (s.4(e)) and to authorise a Standard Mark (s.20) names no IT or data standard and no certified organisation, so no certification fact.
